one_liner: Meta's text-based social app (X/Twitter competitor); the Threads API lets developers publish posts and read replies/insights.

auth.evidence_quote: API authentication is handled by Threads user access tokens that conform to the OAuth 2.0 protocol.
auth.notes: Short-lived tokens last 1 hour and can be exchanged for long-lived tokens valid 60 days; permission grants for public-profile users are valid 90 days.

access.evidence_quote: In order for app users without a role on your app to be able to grant your app these permissions, each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published.
access.notes: Requires a Meta app with the Threads use case and specific permissions (threads_basic, threads_content_publish, etc.); acting on users other than app roles requires App Review approval and app publication.

api.evidence_quote: each permission must first be approved through the App Review process, and your app must be published
api.notes: Threads API surface is small (publish, replies, insights) relative to full Graph API; did not verify official MCP within call budget.

verdict.rationale: Developers get OAuth2 access to their own Threads account for free immediately, but acting on other users' accounts requires Meta App Review of the Threads permissions.
